title: Expression XVIII - Fear of Cancer versus Fear of Crisis – International Patient Survey on the Influence of Crisis on Cancer Patients
summary: The aim of this exploratory survey is to investigate the relationship between fear of recurrence and fear of social crises (e.g. war, pandemic, environmental disasters) in order to better understand their interaction and derive clinical consequences. The results should contribute to the development of specific information services and psychosocial counseling measures for women with gynecological-oncological tumors.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of uterus, part unspecified
Malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified female genital organs
Neoplasm of uncertain or unknown behaviour of female genital organs

interventions.name: The survey is open to all female patients diagnosed with gynecological cancer, including breast cancer, regardless of the stage of disease or treatments received. It focuses on aspects of supportive care, particularly psychological burdens such as fear of recurrence. A minimum age of 18 years is req

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of a gynecological-oncological tumor disease, currently or in the past
Exclusion criteria:
Women under the age of 18
